source.source: Dutton et al. 2011, SWELLS II, Section 5.2, https://arxiv.org/abs/1101.1622
source.interpretation: Model-dependent summary of the observed arc under an SIE lens fit. Compare with area-equivalent tangential critical radius as a preliminary diagnostic, not an image-plane likelihood or an independent raw measurement of enclosed mass.

superposition.area_definition: sqrt(mean(r_critical(phi)^2)); outer tangential root on every ray

gravity_assumption: GR weak-field thin lens; fitted signed density sources both metric potentials equally
comparison_scope: Published SIE summary only. No observed-image pixel likelihood, PSF/dust/source reconstruction, or model evidence computed.
alternatives_note: Up to 20 next-best searched subsets with delta chi2 <= 1; illustrates degeneracy, not a confidence interval.
